nodes.label: Explicit local demo account provisioning
nodes.rationale: Trusted CLI may create four documented fixture accounts for local demonstrations; it is opt-in, atomic and does not reset existing account passwords or progress.

nodes.label: Explicit optional demo role routing
nodes.rationale: CAREER_QUEST_DEMO_MODE=1 explicitly enables unauthenticated role/profile selection. The default application validates persistent accounts.

nodes.label: Ignored local environment configuration
nodes.rationale: dotenv loads local secrets without overriding process variables; example files contain empty keys.

nodes.label: Weekly map research and explicit manual refresh
nodes.norm_label: weekly map research and explicit manual refresh
nodes.rationale: The first map opening may start background research; cached results prevent navigation from creating repeated paid requests. Failure requires manual retry.

nodes.label: HR assigns mandatory training through the shared plan
nodes.norm_label: hr assigns mandatory training through the shared plan
nodes.rationale: HR uses the same cached/budgeted AI research, assigns an existing course or HTTPS link as approved mandatory training, and records a reason. The employee cannot cancel mandatory training; XP and skills still require certificate approval.
nodes.source_location: Сценарий сотрудника и HR / HR → Назначить обучение
